title: EFI and Linux: the future is here, and it's awful - Matthew Garrett
summary: Matthew Garrett's linux.conf.au 2012 talk covers EFI and UEFI from the Linux point of view: why the PC BIOS was bad, what EFI changes, the issues it brings, and Secure Boot.
why: Pointed to as an entertaining, informative explanation of why UEFI is troublesome, from a Linux UEFI developer.

quote.text: A thoroughly entertaining and informative talk on issues including secure boot, but also other issues with UEFI.
